subject.title: fix(acp): keep completed run-mode sessions resumable

question: Should completed parent-owned ACP run-mode sessions remain resumable after task completion when support, stable-identity, and terminal-readiness gates all pass, accepting retained metadata instead of unconditional cleanup?
rationale: This deliberately moves the lifecycle boundary established after stale-session delivery incidents; tests and live proof support the new gates, but repository policy requires owner intent for the compatibility and persisted-session-state tradeoff.

options.title: Accept gated retention
options.body: Approve the support/identity/readiness-gated lifecycle after confirming the stale-session invariants and exact-head required checks.

options.title: Preserve terminal cleanup
options.body: Keep unconditional one-shot cleanup and close or redesign this PR if completed sessions must never remain resumable.

recommendation.title: Accept gated retention
recommendation.body: Approve the support/identity/readiness-gated lifecycle after confirming the stale-session invariants and exact-head required checks.
